zhou: Zhou is the imperial dynasty of China from 1122 to 221 BC.
Zhou means the same as Zhou dynasty or Chou or Chou dynasty.
zhou dynasty: Zhou dynasty is the imperial dynasty of China from 1122 to 221 BC.
Zhou dynasty means the same as Zhou or Chou or Chou dynasty.
zhou en-lai: Zhou En-lai is Chinese revolutionary and communist leader.
Zhou En-lai means the same as Chou En-lai.
zhu jiang: Zhu Jiang is a river in southeast China that flows into the South China Sea.
Zhu Jiang means the same as Canton River or Chu Kiang or Pearl River.
zhuang: Zhuang is a branch of the Tai languages.
zhukov: Zhukov is Soviet general who during World War II directed the counteroffensive at Stalingrad and relieved Leningrad and captured Berlin.
Zhukov means the same as Georgi Zhukov or Georgi Konstantinovich Zhukov.
